work.casesIntro: Manage synthetic banking work with a recorded human review.
work.humanNotice: Synthetic data only. Closing a case records an internal workflow decision; it does not approve a loan, block a transaction, or change an account.
work.title: Title
work.syntheticConfirm: I confirm this contains synthetic data only.
work.independentReview: The reviewer must be different from the case creator and the latest submitter. Explain your decision (at least 10 characters).
work.documentIntro: Private document storage, queued processing, and validated field extraction.
work.caseIdHint: Open Documents from a case to fill this automatically.
work.textOnly: Supported format: UTF-8 .txt, up to 1 MiB. Optional extraction fields: reference, applicant, amount, currency (one label: value per line). Instruction-like content is blocked from retrieval.
work.policyIntro: Find supporting excerpts in indexed synthetic policies.
work.policyNotice: Default: deterministic mock evidence selection. Responses quote stored chunks; unsupported questions receive no answer. Document instructions never grant permissions or execute tools.
work.question: Your policy question
work.amlIntro: Explainable synthetic rules linked to the case-review workflow.
work.amlNotice: Simulation only. These example thresholds are not regulatory rules. An alert is a review prompt, not evidence of wrongdoing. No freezing, blocking, reporting, or other external action occurs.
work.activityIntro: Trace stored actions and model executions.
work.executionScope: Administrators and auditors see all executions. Other users see their own. Token usage is shown only when supplied by the provider.
